name: Barge bumpers and boat landing fenders
description: The fender frame and landing structure on a jacket leg that absorbs supply-boat and barge impact and gives personnel a ladder access at the waterline. The bumper protects the leg; the boat landing carries the fendering and the access ladder.

specifications.metric: Boat landing — conductor diameter it clamps to
specifications.basis: US4679964A description: conductor pipe 'typically in the range of about 26 to about 30 inches in diameter' with wall thickness about one inch; boat landing clamped to it at the water line.

specifications.metric: Boat landing — example anchor pile length
specifications.basis: US4679964A description: 'the piling is 70 feet in length' with about 52 feet protruding into the seabed.

specifications.metric: Boat landing — clamp-base footprint of prior-art Sea Horse system
specifications.basis: US4932811A background: 'The base of the sea horse clamp is approximately forty by forty feet square where piling are driven through the cans'.

gaps.what: Barge bumper energy rating and fender stiffness
gaps.why: The carried figures are geometry only; no page read gives a bumper energy absorption or fender stiffness value.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a barge-bumper/fender datasheet and record energy rating, reaction force and deflection

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
